subject: Accessing the chisq data with Crosstable function

messages.author: f18fd7644b819ce3
messages.subject: Accessing the chisq data with Crosstable function
parts:
Hi everyone, I'm using the Crosstable function from the gmodels package. The output object has some values, but I can't access the chisq one.

example:
y <- CrossTable(varx,vary,chisq=TRUE)
y #prints everything including chisq OK
y$t    #prints a simple table with n's
y$chisq  # only outputs "TRUE" instead of an object like chisq.test

Am I missing something? I want to access the chisq.test p.value directly. I can of course run a chisq.test instead of CrossTable seperately..


Thanks
